ops.sql: SELECT Connector_ID, Connector_Type, Start_Object_ID, End_Object_ID, SourceIsAggregate, DestIsAggregate, SourceIsNavigable, DestIsNavigable FROM t_connector WHERE Connector_Type = 'Aggregation' AND (Start_Object_ID IN (11962,11966,11970,11974) OR End_Object_ID IN (11962,11966,11970,11974,12237))
SELECT Diagram_ID, Name, Notes, StyleEx, Diagram_Type FROM t_diagram WHERE ea_guid = '{FFDF5888-A86C-4f50-9152-8EA81C219199}' OR Diagram_ID = 1247
SELECT o.Object_ID, o.Name, d.RectLeft, d.RectTop, d.RectRight, d.RectBottom FROM t_diagramobjects d INNER JOIN t_object o ON o.Object_ID = d.Object_ID WHERE d.Diagram_ID = 1208
SELECT Object_ID, Object_Type, Classifier, ParentID FROM t_object WHERE ParentID IN (12272,12318,12409,12419,12567,12425,12430,12435,12287)

SELECT Connector_ID, DiagramID, SeqNo, Start_Object_ID, End_Object_ID, Name, PDATA1 FROM t_connector WHERE Connector_Type = 'Sequence' AND DiagramID IN (1274,1310,1382,1390,1506,1394,1398,1402,1286) ORDER BY DiagramID, SeqNo
SELECT Diagram_ID, Object_ID, RectLeft, RectTop, RectRight, RectBottom FROM t_diagramobjects WHERE Diagram_ID IN (1274,1310,1382,1390,1506,1394,1398,1402,1286)
SELECT Object_ID, Name FROM t_object WHERE Package_ID = 1137
